edits.rationale: Unit 18 has the largest stop_dist weight (-1.71) and top failure-window attribution; halve it.
Unit 41 has a large negative stop_dist weight (-1.12); halve it.
Unit 43 has the largest positive stop_dist weight (1.19); halve it.
Unit 51 has a stop_dist weight of -0.74; halve it.
Unit 53 has a stop_dist weight of -0.80; halve it.

hypothesis: In the merge deadlock, a large stop_dist input (above about 3) flips alpha_v from about +0.68 to about -0.94 through a few h1 units with large stop_dist weights. Halving those weights (units 18, 41, 43, 51, 53) raises the flip threshold, so the vehicle keeps moving in failure states while keeping the stop behaviour.
expected_effect: Failure states with large stop_dist keep alpha_v positive and the deadlock is released. In rollouts, 9 of 10 OOD seeds succeeded (seed 50009 collided) and 5 of 5 nominal seeds completed with score 100.
